1.o: Sarah, a streetwise hustler on the run from a lifetime of bad decisions, witnesses the suicide of a stranger who looks just like her. Sarah assumes her identity, hoping that cleaning out the dead woman’s bank account will solve all of her problems. Instead, the street smart chameleon is thrust headlong into a kaleidoscopic mystery. After taking on the new identity, Sarah quickly finds herself caught in the middle of a deadly conspiracy and must race to find answers.

2.o: With a body in her car and nowhere to turn, Sarah is forced to continue her con and earn “Beth” a second chance on the force. But with a killer on her tail, her only hope of finding answers lies with another apparent ‘identical,’ Alison.

3.o: Rocked by the revelation that she and her fellow "Orphans" are clones, Sarah just wants to get her hands on the money and skip town. But Sarah’s fake detective ruse stretches thin when the cops find the body she buried and assign “Beth” to the case. As Sarah closes in on the killer, the hunter becomes the hunted.

4.o: Sarah realizes that the Orphans’ survival is going to take more than police work. But tracking the killer threatens Sarah’s long awaited reunion with her daughter, Kira. As Sarah gets closer to the killer, the killer gets closer to the truth – the ensuing showdown threatens to expose her ruse as a cop.

5.o: When terrifying evidence suggests the Orphans are part of a sinister ongoing experiment, Sarah’s suspicions turn to Paul, Beth’s boyfriend. But her probing inadvertently triggers Paul’s own investigation, bringing him dangerously close to the truth. Meanwhile, paranoid Alison piles on a whole new level of complication.

6.o: Sarah’s hunt for answers is interrupted by a trip to the suburbs. Alison’s paranoia has boiled over, putting all the Orphans at risk. But when Sarah, Alison and Beth’s worlds dangerously collide, Sarah must decide who to trust with her secret.

7.t: Parts Developed in an Unusual Manner
7.o: With Paul missing, Sarah is forced to confront the conspiracy head on. But when Paul learns Sarah has kept essential information from him, the fragile trust between them threatens to shatter. Meanwhile, Cosima grows closer to Delphine and the dangerously fascinating Dr. Leekie.

8.o: Sarah's actions pit the Orphans against each other as she tries to plan her next move. As Paul tries desperately to cover up Sarah’s existence, Alison takes vengeance on her suspected monitor, which could cost her everything she holds dear.

9.o: After Kira’s life is threatened, Sarah is on the warpath, but Dr. Leekie makes her think twice about her plans for revenge. Meanwhile, Cosima faces the truth about Delphine, forcing her to choose sides. Now, it’s up to Sarah to decide the killer’s fate, but the truth about where Sarah came from changes everything.

10.o: Sarah’s last chance to bring her nemesis back to sanity slips away as Art intervenes to get answers of his own. Meanwhile, the Orphans must decide whether to make peace with their creators, as Sarah is forced into a deadly confrontation with their enemy.

1.o: Sarah is out of options, on the run, and pursued by deadly adversaries. Desperate to find her daughter Kira, Sarah suspects ruthless pro-clone Rachel is behind her daughter’s disappearance and sparks an all out war against her. Alison and Donnie attend the funeral of her fallen friend, Aynsley, causing Alison to sink into guilt and despair. Cosima is faced with a perplexing decision that may have dire consequences.

2.t: Governed by Sound Reason and True Religion
2.o: While Alison struggles with Aynsley's death and Cosima grapples with the worsening symptoms of her mysterious sickness, Sarah enlists Art’s help to find Kira and is shocked when she learns where the trail leads.

3.t: Mingling Its Own Nature with It
3.o: After hitting the road with Felix, Sarah is forced to turn to a ghost from her past - an old flame named Cal Morrison. When their brief respite is brutally shattered, Sarah realizes that no matter how far she runs, it will never be far enough.

4.t: Governed As It Were by Chance
4.o: Sarah comes home looking for answers, and with the help of Cosima, they begin digging into the origins of the clone experiment. The hunt for answers takes her right into the belly of the beast, but getting out could cost her more than she knows.

5.o: Rachel goes on the warpath, lashing out at Sarah's nearest and dearest. While she tries to keep her loved ones safe, an unexpected visitor threatens to derail Sarah's plans.

6.t: To Hound Nature in Her Wanderings
6.o: Sarah joins forces with an unlikely and untrustworthy ally, following a trail of clues that she hopes will lead her to the origins of the clone experiment. Cosima and Delphine make a discovery that could prove to be the key to treating her illness. Alison finds herself in unsavory company at rehab.

7.t: Knowledge of Causes, and Secret Motion of Things
7.o: When a rehab confidante betrays Alison and threatens to expose the truth about Aynsley’s death, she goes into free fall on the eve of Family Day. With Donnie and the kids set to visit, it’s all clones on deck to contain the fallout.

8.o: A new player in the clone conspiracy turns up at Felix’s door, sending him into crisis mode. With Cosima running out of options, Sarah struggles with the decision to surrender a crucial piece of leverage and make a deal with Dyad.

9.t: Things Which Have Never Yet Been Done
9.o: Cosima takes a turn for the worse, forcing Sarah to take desperate action which results in tragic consequences for those she loves. The Proletheans set their ultimate plan in motion, while Alison and Donnie tangle with the law.

10.t: By Means Which Have Never Yet Been Tried
10.o: The war with Dyad is all but lost when Rachel’s latest ploy forces a broken Sarah to concede. The Clone Club springs into action, uniting in a reckless gambit to save Sarah. As they fight to gain their freedom, Sarah encounters a new ally and uncovers a terrifying new dimension to the conspiracy.

1.o: When the menace of Castor rears its head once more, Sarah and her entire family must come together to survive.

2.o: Castor pursues the Leda clones for original tissue samples. Helena, who is pregnant and imprisoned, is examined by a mysterious new villain. The Castor boys are also out to play, toying with a frightened young woman, Patty, in a sexy switcheroo that ultimately sets Sarah – and Art – hot on the Castor trail. But it’s not all fun and games for the Castor boys, as Sarah gleans they may have a mysterious defect that puts their lives in peril.

3.o: Leda and Castor are both on the hunt for original clone DNA. On-the-lam, Mark and Gracie pursue new leads to find the samples that might set them free, while Art and Sarah reunite to track them down. Meanwhile, Cosima and Scott try to learn more about Castor’s biology and Alison’s new money-making venture is going gangbusters. A shocking revelation about the Castor-Leda connection leaves the sisters reeling, just before Sarah witnesses a deadly Prolethean-Castor face-off.

4.o: Mark is taken down in a Prolethean shoot-out and Sarah must step in to help. But as Sarah gathers intel that puts her on the trail of the original Castor DNA, a familiar foe is not far behind. While Helena continues to toil in a faraway military compound, it is ultimately Sarah’s fate that will hang in the balance as she tries to save her sister. Meanwhile, Gracie is cast out from the Prolethean fold, and Alison and Donnie come face-to-face with unhappy drug lord, Jason Kellerman.

5.o: Helena and Sarah are reunited at the Castor camp. As Sarah suffers testing, Paul appears to chide her; but his allegiances are beginning to strain. While the Leda family worries about Sarah’s absence, Gracie ‘breaks loose’ under the care of Mrs. S and an unwilling Felix. Cosima falls hard for an internet date, Shay.

6.o: Paul digs and finds the ugly truth behind the Castor Boys’ logbooks of names, pushing him into action. Meanwhile, Felix is desperate for info on Sarah’s whereabouts, and presses the still-ailing Rachel for any shred of a lead. In order for Donnie and Alison to take their money-making endeavor to the “next level” she must introduce Jason Kellerman to her unique business plan.

7.t: Community of Dreadful Fear and Hate
7.o: Alison must secure a store front in order to take her and Donnie’s business to the “next level”. But things don’t go according to plan when her mother, Connie, proves to be a major hindrance. Cosima is facing familiar health issues and calls upon beleaguered Alison for a favor. But with Alison working to save an imperiled Donnie from the merciless hands of a drug lord, it’s Cosima who ends up doing a favor. An unassuming Scott gets closer to the greatest discovery of all, when he sits down with beleaguered clone Rachel.

8.t: Ruthless in Purpose, and Insidious in Method
8.o: When Rachel makes a promise to Sarah, it comes with a hefty price. Meanwhile, Helena and Gracie work with the Hendrixes, and Donnie takes Kellerman to task. Over at Castor, Coady and Benchman scheme to track down the Castor Original, and Rudy descends on DYAD for a much needed asset.

9.o: Sarah, Felix, and Mrs. S are in London to track down the Castor Original, but their enemies are not far behind.

10.o: Castor and Topside force Sarah to make uneasy alliances. But there is some rest for the wicked, when Donnie gives Helena an unexpected ‘gift’, and the results of Alison’s candidacy finally come in. Even as team Leda takes a moment to breathe, change is afoot and a life hangs in the balance.

1.o: After two months of respite, Sarah’s hard-won refuge in Iceland is shattered by a Neolution attack. Once again forced to flee, she realizes no matter how far her family runs it will never be far enough.

2.o: After evading a Neolution attack in Iceland, Sarah returns home to track down an elusive new ally. As Cosima struggles with Delphine’s disappearance, Alison and Donnie host a pregnant and ever-hungry Helena. Meanwhile Felix, feeling like an outsider, embarks on his own journey of self-discovery.

3.o: As Sarah reels from the shocking discovery of Neolution’s biotech, she’s desperate to find answers. Rachel receives a visit from her keeper and takes a fraught step forward towards recovery. Meanwhile, Helena is mistaken for “Mrs. Hendrix” when she answers a visit from suspicious visitors.

4.o: Sarah realizes her goals have aligned with her once enemy and forms a precarious alliance in hopes of getting to the head of Neolution. Meanwhile, on her end, Alison dispatches Felix and Donnie to infiltrate a Neolution fertility clinic that Beth investigated. Back at the lab, Cosima and Scott receive a revolting delivery from Alison. As Rachel grows closer to Charlotte, Susan Duncan leaves a devastating decision in her hands.

5.o: Sarah’s day off to reconnect with Kira quickly turns into a sleuthing mission aimed squarely at discrediting Felix’s new ties. Cosima steps up with Donnie to further investigate the Neolutionist fertility research center. While Donnie bumps into an all too familiar face, Cosima makes a shocking discovery that leads her into a dangerous encounter.

6.o: When Cosima admits doubts about finding a cure in time to save her life, Sarah makes a lone decision that exposes Kendall to those she’s spent years hiding from. Meanwhile, Art and Felix team up to protect naïve clone, Krystal Godderitch, from herself.

7.o: Sarah regresses to old habits while struggling to cope with the consequences of her decisions —reconnecting with Beth on a dark night of the soul. Back at the lab, Cosima, haunted by vicious memories and news of Delphine, attempts a dangerous Hail Mary to find a cure. At the Hendrixes, Alison is more determined than ever to create normalcy for her kids. As she forges ahead with a birthday party, Donnie is caught in the Neolution crosshairs.

8.o: As Alison is terrified by Neolution threats made against Donnie, Sarah and Mrs. S question her loyalty to her sisters. While Sarah is distracted, Siobhan sneaks out to seek vengeance. Meanwhile, Cosima and Susan Duncan work together in a final attempt to discover a cure.

9.o: With Susan Duncan deposed, Sarah finds herself in the same position as Rachel — under the heel of a new HBIC — causing the archenemies to come together for the greater good. Cosima and Susan butt heads on the ethical implications of human experiments. Meanwhile, when the Hendrixes' legal counsel, Adele, further investigates Donnie’s case, she begins to suspect Felix is keeping deep secrets. Helena’s arrival forces Felix to make a difficult decision.

10.o: When communication with Cosima is cut off and Neolution appears to be within striking distance, Sarah's alliance with Rachel goes out the window. Sarah lures a high-level Neolutionist into a trap, and sets out to bring down Neolution once and for all.

1.o: Sarah is deeply wounded and struggling to stay alive on the Island. Driven deep into its forest by Neolutionists and worse, she strives to make it far enough to rescue Cosima. Meanwhile, a recovering Cosima reunites with Delphine, but there's way more going on on this Island than Cosima imagined and Delphine can't give her all the answers she needs. What is clear is that Rachel is now firmly in charge as the right-hand of the 170-year-old founder of Neolution, P. T. Westmorland. Back home, Neolution puts the screws to Alison and Donnie in their hunt for Helena. The sestras couldn't be further

2.o: Captured by Neolution Sarah receives a damning ultimatum from Rachel: come into the fold, or lose your family. Her decision causes a clash with Kira who begins exploring her own maturity. Meanwhile, Ferdinand struggles to get a handle on Rachel's new velvet glove mandate in pursuit of the clones. With Neolutionists and Ferdinand watching their every move, Felix brings an old ally into the mix to help his family get Kira to safety. On the Island, Cosima struggles to comprehend the reality of the Neolution myth made real.

3.o: Stuck on the sidelines with Neolutionists crawling all over her home, Alison seeks to return to her community center, but Bailey Downs has moved on from her. As she flounders to take back some semblance of control, the ghost of friendships' past rears its handsome head. Art and his new partner show up at the Hendrix residence to continue their search for Helena, forcing Art to make a difficult moral judgement.

4.t: Let the Children and Childbearers Toil
4.o: Following up on intel from a mysterious source, Mrs. S heads on the road with Sarah to investigate a lead on a Neolution defector. Meanwhile, an unexpected reunion takes place on the island, while Cosima's research leads her to a discovery more terrible than she could have ever imagined. As more pieces slide into place, the puzzle only seems to become more complicated.

5.o: While Sarah and Kira spend some well-needed bonding time at home, secrets are unlocked about Kira’s special gifts that are surprisingly linked to the island’s creature. Meanwhile, Cosima joins Delphine at the mansion for a twisted family dinner, causing a dangerous showdown with the Neolution patriarch.

6.o: Cosima is forced into an alliance when an old enemy returns to the island, accelerating P. T. Westmorland's sinister agenda. Meanwhile, on the mainland, Krystal stumbles onto a vital clue to the Neolution endgame. Sarah and Mrs. S’s research into Neolution's corporate ties leads to the cosmetics industry and an inevitable cross with Krystal Goderitch. But before Sarah can dig deeper, Krystal hijacks the investigation.

7.o: As P. T. Westmorland demands a more aggressive action on Kira, and Sarah fights to save her daughter, Rachel discovers a dark secret that makes her question her place within Neolution. Meanwhile, Cosima has returned with a vital clue to Westmorland's true identity.

8.o: Mrs. S orders the sisters to take a night off from sleuthing to celebrate Felix's art opening. But while Felix attempts to impress a famous gallerist with the help of his sestras, Sarah remains on edge with a nagging suspicion that S is hiding something. Meanwhile, wounded and desperate, Rachel reunites with an old ally, but their plans for revenge on Neolution put Clone Club in the line of fire.

9.o: A devastating loss is eclipsed when word reaches Sarah that Helena has been kidnapped. Clone Club bands together in a race against time, determined to find her before she has her babies. And with time running out, Sarah is forced into action in a last-ditch effort to save her sestra.

10.t: To Right the Wrongs of Many
10.o: With Helena forced to take shelter behind enemy lines, it’s a bloody last stand for survival as Sarah and Art struggle to protect her, and end the siege on the sestras once and for all.

1.o: Yamada Ryu, a second year student who attends the prestigious Suzaku Private High School, is a problem child who comes to school late and leaves early, is prone to fighting all over the place, and even nods off in class. One day, he falls down the stairs with the honor student Shiraishi Urara. They faint, and when he wakes up in the infirmary he's turned into her!

2.o: Ito Miyabi, who loves supernatural phenomena, appears just as Yamada, Urara, and Miyamura restart Supernatural Studies Club activities. Miyabi shows off her supernatural paraphernalia so proudly that Yamada and the others can't tell her the truth: that they only want to use the clubroom to kiss.

3.t: Will You Accept? Or Won't You?
3.o: "They won't give us a club budget?" Miyabi is unhappy the Supernatural Studies Club can't move forward with their research because the student council won't give them funding. Yamada isn't interested initially, but quickly changes his mind once he learns he could buy a microwave to warm up his beloved yakisoba bread.

4.t: It Looks Like I’ve Fallen for Yamada!
4.o: "We're going on the school camping trip today, huh?" Yamada is less than thrilled, but gets his fill of all he wants to do after switching bodies with Urara and thinks, "Looks like this'll be sorta fun now!" However, Urara has never really fit in with the other girls.

5.o: "Keep this a secret from Shiraishi!" Just as Yamada decides to keep the fact his kiss' power has changed to "Charm" a secret from Urara, she urges him to switch bodies. He'd better go see Odagiri Nene and get his power back to normal in a hurry! Elsewhere, Nene is irritated that Yamada hasn't become charmed by her kiss and shown up like he's supposed to.

6.o: "It's summer! It's the beach! It's a summer retreat!" The Supernatural Studies Club holds a summer retreat at the club house to find volume two of the notebook containing the legend of the witches, but Yamada's spirits plummet as he is forced to take supplementary lessons and exams with Otsuka Meiko, Tsurukawa Hideaki, and Kameda Mitsuru from the Manga Research Club.

7.o: Yamada begins searching for the witches and visits the home of the fourth witch, Sarushima Maria, who is a shut-in taking a break from school. When they're alone, she tells him that her power is to see the future of the person she kisses.

8.o: Yamada's group gets roped into making the group of first-year problem students lead by Takigawa Noa behave in order to open a yakisoba bread stand at the cultural festival. Noa is a witch, and appears to see the past of the person she kisses and latch onto their shortcomings. Worst yet, she seems to have volume two of the notebook containing the legend of the witches!

9.t: Be Sure to Change the Future
9.o: Suzaku Fest is here! Thanks to copying Maria's power to predict the future, Yamada's fortunes guaranteed to strike home make the Supernatural Studies Club's yakisoba bread shop a huge success. Meanwhile, Maria confides in Yamada and tells him she wants to erase her witch power. "I want to kiss and fall in love like a normal person."

10.o: The Supernatural Studies Club meets Miyamura's sister, Leona, in their search for the seventh witch. She has dropped out of school in order to escape from that witch's power to erase memories. The instant one learns her name, all of their memories related to witches will be erased.

11.t: What Did You Do With Shiraishi?!
11.o: Unable to stand by and do nothing after seeing Urara's tears, Yamada tries to kiss her to prove she's really a witch, but she refuses. Yamada and Tamaki, unwilling to give up, continue trying to find a way to restore everyone's lost memories.

12.o: Yamada must get all the witches together to conduct the seven witches' ceremony, and the last three needed are Urara, Mikoto, and Rika. Hoping to at least save Urara, Yamada heads for Mikoto's house along with the student council president Miyamura, but they're stopped by Miyamura's sister Leona.

1.o: Alia arrives in Lebanon to bring her late husband’s body to his estranged family. She knows nothing about them, and things immediately seem strange.

2.o: It's been a week since the funeral, and Alia is increasingly on edge. Bodyguards are with her constantly and the family is clearly hiding something.

3.o: Despite being forced to extend her stay, Alia is determined to return to Canada with her son. Cautiously, she begins to open up to Jabal.

4.o: Naim informs Alia that Jabal is involved in major criminal activity. Nahed refuses to allow Alia to leave for Beirut with Joe.

5.o: Jabal's henchman Debb is arrested on homicide charges. Alia meets Majdi, Mona's estranged husband, and learns something disturbing about Adel.

6.o: Alia is distraught to learn the details of the family business. She doesn't want this life for herself or her son, but Nahed refuses to let them go.

7.o: The fight between Nidal and Sakher escalates to a tense standoff between families. Jabal tries to stop Alia when he finds out she's run away with Joe.

8.o: After her attempted escape, Alia is given an ultimatum: stay with her son and become a part of the family, or return to Canada alone.

9.o: Alia steels herself for a tough legal battle to get her son back. Jabal tracks down Naim and makes sure he'll never help Alia again.

10.o: The lawyer Majdi recommends seems very capable, but Alia has reservations about his fee. Chahine visits his father in prison.

11.o: Chahine is torn between his father and his loyalty to Jabal. Joe starts to really miss his mother. After meeting with her lawyer, Alia is optimistic.

12.o: Mona begins to receive texts from her estranged husband. Nidal confronts Alia. Jabal refuses to allow Joe to see Alia. Debb gets released on bail.

13.o: Just as things are looking up with Alia's court case, Jabal meets and threatens Alia's lawyer. Ghada's daughter wants to move back in with her.

14.o: Mona is forced out of the family home for attempting to reunite Joe with his mother. With her lawyer turning on her, Alia is now truly out of options.

15.o: Nahed tries to prevent Alia from renting a place anywhere in Al Hayba, thereby forcing Alia to move in with the family under the matriarch's terms.

16.o: After holding her son in her arms again, Alia makes her decision: She will marry Jabal, but she makes it clear that she won't be a submissive wife.

17.o: Ghada is upset that Jabal has married another woman. Despite chafing under her restrictive new life, Alia proves her capability in the kitchen.

18.o: Alia wants Jabal to make it clear to his mother that their marriage is just an arrangement of convenience. Alia is secretly still planning an escape.

19.o: Knowing how bored she is at home, Jabal gets Alia a job running their family-owned yogurt factory. Chahine falls deeper in with Dorayd and Zidan.

20.o: After hearing from Chahine that Dorayd needs more time to find Ronny, Jabal gives him 10 more days -- or else. Alia and Jabal begin to grow closer.

21.o: Ghada is shocked to see Alia walk into her clinic for a checkup. A capable engineer named Amal interviews for a position at the factory.

22.o: While intercepting one of Zidan's cars, Jabal finds a frightened young woman named Hanady and brings her home. Alia takes her under her wing.

23.o: Hanady must decide to either stay or return to Zidan. Jabal deals with Dorayd. Alia and Joe are caught in the crossfire in an ambush targeting Jabal.

26.o: Mona tells Majdi that she wants a divorce. Chahine is transferred to a prison cell with his father. Jabal and Alia have an emotional confrontation.

27.o: After Alia gives Ghada a piece of her mind, Ghada crosses the line and goes to Jabal's family home. Jabal agrees to be tested for fertility issues.

28.o: While getting ready for a date with Jabal, Alia tells Mona that yes, she has feelings for her husband. Sakher pays Rima's blackmailer a visit.

Thus begins the search for its owner, but having grown attached to the cat, Aya can't quite put her heart into the search.

7.o: Without work, Rie and co vent their dissatisfaction and lay into themselves. That's when an energetic and optimistic new member called Myojin Rinne approaches the three and-

8.o: Until now, Shiho has acted her lines according to the requirements and never had to do a retake. However, deep down she had some concerns about this.

9.o: The crowdfunding for "Project Vogel" reached the goal of 3,000,000 Yen without incident, meaning Yuuki and her team are going to devote their time to becoming the hyperdimensional space idols, "chun×4 (Fortune)". Seeing their costumes and hearing their debut song really gets them excited. Following right after that, they hear that the details for their release event are also set. However, a mysterious shadow tails Yuzuha, almost as if this was too much happiness...

10.o: While Maika had been doing just fine at the post-recordings, when the anime is about to get to its climax, she finds herself faced with a big wall.

11.o: In order to reach the people who supposed the crowdfunding campaign, chun×4 are going on tour to various locations. The first stop is Chisa's hometown, Niigata. As soon as they get there, the four jump right into an interview with a local paper and a radio show, but for some reason Chisa doesn't look too thrilled... When the other three ask her what's wrong, she ends up raising her voice at them. What could have caused this, when Chisa is usually so put together?

12.o: It's already time for the post-recording of the final anime episode. Having done her best as the show regular so far, something miraculous happens to Haruna...

13.o: With the three others in her group, Rie goes into the audition for season two of "Flowers in full bloom! Bloom Ball", however, while they are being judged, a fight breaks out amongst them...

14.o: Miharu and the rest of the radio crew tell the listeners of their radio show "Ride the Headwind" that they sadly did not make it through the anime audition. While all of them are sad about it, Miharu says that fate hadn't brought them and their roles together yet. Perhaps it was fate playing a trick, but right after the broadcast was over, the four girls received a strange email.

15.t: Actually, I Won't Take This Job
15.o: Right after being cast for "Flowers in full bloom! Bloom Ball", Satori receives an offer to be in an anime alongside a huge voice acting star.

16.o: Miharu, Aya, Mahoro, and Riko received an offer from a person called Masapi-. The four make it over to the studio once again, in order to record using motion capture. And just like that, a single email set their fate into motion. Also, Mahoro receives a message from her old grade school, saying that they have her time capsule. However, she seems completely uninterested in going...

17.o: It's the showcase episode for Shoubu Ayame, who's voiced by Honoka. As there are so many lines, Honoka gets overwhelmed, and to make matters worse, the director only has harsh words for her.

18.o: The day before the live show where Project Himmel's new unit "LUNA ω rabbits" are revealed, Mei gets a slight fever and has to stay in bed. Worried about her, Satori and Rinne take turns visiting and talk about a side of Rie that Mei didn't know yet. Having been together with Rie since her childhood, hearing this warms Mei's heart.

19.o: Despite their already busy schedule, Rie and her team are to do a stage reading for children. Will they be able to finish this gig without incident?

20.o: The live anime project "Adventure Survivors", which got its start because of a web radio show, is renewed for another season. On top of that, Miharu, Aya, Mahoro, and Riko are officially added to the roster of Project Himmel, joining Chun×4 and LUNA ω rabbits. But then, Mahoro accidentally overhears something that dampens the mood. It is a discussion about Miharu's plans to study abroad, when it was her who had been keeping their team together, rain or shine...

21.o: Yuuki's trademark is being full of energy, but lately she's been late to the lessons, making mistakes, and overall not being like herself. When Chisa, Airi, and Yuzuha ask Yuuki what the issue is, she replies that she's helping at her parents' restaurant because it's so busy. But that can't quite explain the situation. As Project Himmel's live show is coming up, the members bonding closer together is essential, so what is going on with Yuuki at this crucial time?

22.o: It's finally the day for Project Himmel's live show. While each one of them has their own thoughts, the hearts of the 16 members are united.

23.o: Rie hasn't been able to fully believe in her own acting so far, but then on the final day of the post-recording, she awakens her true potential.

24.o: For new voice actresses, the success rate at auditions is much lower than the failure rate. Even though it seemed that the members of AiRBLUE had leapt right into a glamorous career, this reality applies as well. There are even days when nothing seems to work, and things are starting to look bleak. But then, almost as if to sweep away that depressing mood, an audition for the anime "Alma of the Azure Valley" comes up, the anime that was the reason for Haruna to pursue voice acting.

1.o: When she returns home for her sister's wedding, Anita accidentally goes back in time and travels to her first day of high school.

2.o: After discovering how she can keep traveling to the past, Anita sets out to fix her cousin Carol's love life with the help of bad boy Fabrício.

3.o: In 2006, Anita lands in hot water when her scheme with Fabrício is exposed. Cé gets mad at Anita. Meanwhile, Henrique confesses his feelings.

4.o: Following a chat with her dad, 15-year-old Anita decides to stop meddling and apologizes to Carol and Cé. Luiza and Fabrício go on a date.

5.o: Things take a left turn at Luiza's 17th birthday party when a secret is revealed. Cé learns a shocking truth. Anita worries Joel might be on to her.

6.o: Back in the present, Anita has a seemingly perfect life, while Luiza's looks very different. Joel uncovers an explosive secret.

1.o: A bug in Anita's photoblog forces Joel to time-travel back to 2006. Meanwhile, there's a talent show, revealing hidden aptitudes and secret feelings.

2.o: After seeing shocking versions of their own lives, Anita and Joel make a plan to fix the future. César and Fabrício join them on a trip to São Paulo.

3.o: Carol takes a quiz to decide which boy she has a bigger crush on. Meanwhile, Joel helps Henrique and his band record a music video for a festival.

4.o: The inter-school games are on! While Carol tries to keep her eyes on the prize, Henrique tells Anita how he feels. The last match has a sad outcome.

5.o: Anita spends 15 years away from Imperatriz to deal with her grief, until an unexpected action from her mother brings her back to a very different town.

6.o: Joel and Anita can finally set their plan in motion during a June party. Camila makes her debut. A relationship flourishes in a kissing booth.

1.o: Anita finds herself sharing a student residence with her best friends and attending art classes at university — until someone messes with her timeline.

2.o: A flip cup competition resolves a fraternity standoff. Henrique and Carol discuss their future. Anita investigates the mysterious time traveler.

3.o: Anita suspects Jéssica's fake ID. Camila's teacher introduces her to a residency. The girls confront a blackmailer in an epic showdown.

4.o: Anita and Joel find the photoblog's creator living in the woods and convince their friends to go camping. Tensions rise as the group splits up.

5.o: Anita wakes up in a time loop and attempts to help all her friends to break free. The time traveler is revealed.

6.o: After discovering the time traveler's plans, Anita must journey back in time to set things right — and hopefully rebuild her friendships.

1.o: A growing comedy drama depicting the salty daily life of an idol who suffers from hardships despite rising to stardom.
Amanda Pharrell, an eccentric private investigator with a disturbing criminal past, recruits disgraced ex-cop Ted Conkaffey, to help solve the disappearance of a Korean tech pioneer.

2.o: Ted and Amanda's hard work leads to Jong Min's remains being found in the river. Amanda is convinced there's a link between this death, and that of her friend Lars.

3.o: A shocking revelation of an affair leads Amanda and Ted to focus their attention on Yoon Sun and Olivia as prime suspects, while Ted is confronted to discover his past is still very much in the present.

4.o: More of Jong Min's remains are recovered, leading Ted and Amanda's investigation down a darker path, just as Ted receives bombshell news from home.

5.o: Amanda is shocked to discover the attack on Ted, and is determined to find the culprit.

6.o: A major breakthrough in the investigation is threatened when Amanda's past erupts into the present.

7.o: Amanda takes a huge risk playing Twist and Bryce off against each other, and uncovers the truth about Lars' death.

8.o: Uncovering the truth about Park's death brings little comfort for Ted and Amanda; but Ted's digging into Amanda's past finally pays off, and she is able to confront her demons.

1.o: Yurika Nanba is an attractive women who has no problems socially communicating with others, but when it comes to having romantic relationships, she seems to struggle. This is mainly due to her ex-boyfriend Makoto Saito, who was the first guy that she ever had a relationship with.

2.o: Yurika is in shock, after being recommended by Makoto to purchase a room in an apartment. Meanwhile, after hearing about the story from Makoto, his co-workers from the estate agency tries to pursuade him to think about her feelings before making such a comment...

3.o: Makoto tells Yurika that he’s rooting for her current relationship with Yamashita. Meanwhile, she once again decides to continue living in a world of Makoto, as she tries to restore her shocked status…

4.o: After being kissed by Makoto on the night of the birthday party, Yurika becomes convinced that she still has feelings for him. Meanwhile, after witnessing the moment of their kiss, Yurika's friend, Hiromi is doubtful of Makoto's approach...

5.o: Despite going over to Yurika’s place to apologise, Makoto gets sent away by her. Meanwhile, Yamashita comforts a down in the dumps Makoto, at his apartment…

6.o: Makoto decides to have a serious talk with Yurika by going to her apartment. However, he witnesses her with another guy when she returns…

7.o: After Makochi comes out about his feelings for Yurika, they decide to re-start their relationship once again. Meanwhile, Yurika gets a warm support from her work-mates too…

8.o: “Let’s think seriously about our future…” Even though he said these words to Yurika, Makochi still feels unconfident about actually going ahead with it…

9.o: After having suspicious thoughts about Makochi's relationship with a specific woman, Yurika begins to feel uncertain about her feelings towards him. Meanwhile, Yamashita tries to comfort her...

1.o: Top Stasi agent Kleo Straub liquidates a target in a West German nightclub. Soon after, she must face a life-changing betrayal and a heartbreaking loss.

2.o: Determined to find her files, Kleo tracks down her former handler and makes her way into Stasi headquarters. Later, she seeks out Thilo in a dance club.

3.o: Kleo heads to Mallorca, chased by Sven. She infiltrates a party and uses a toxin to paralyze Wieczorek's wife, leading him to make a deadly confession.

4.o: With Min and Uwe on her tail, Kleo bribes a little girl to deliver a poisoned Bundt cake to Mielke's jail cell. After a showdown, Kleo digs up a letter.

5.o: Kleo and Sven form a wary alliance. Anne visits Kleo claiming to look for her grandfather. After failing to kill her, Uwe sets up a meeting with Kleo.

6.o: Severely wounded in a shooting, Kleo has a revealing flashback. With the ominous red suitcase seemingly in hand, Sven shares a devastating truth.

7.o: After Andi is wounded by Kleo, a double agent prevents him from unpacking the conspiracy behind the red suitcase. Sven, Kleo and Min move in on a mole.

8.o: Kleo and Sven arrive in Chile, where they track down an elusive Jorge. Later they tangle with Ramona, whose water breaks at an inopportune moment.

1.o: A surprise visit from her mother puts Kleo back on the trail of the red suitcase, which could have an unsettling link to her childhood.

2.o: Kleo plans a daring heist to retrieve classified files from the KGB, unaware that Sven is after them as well.

3.o: Kleo follows a lead to Belgrade, where Sven makes a romantic connection. Thilo is on a mission of his own.

4.o: Thilo discovers that his soulmate is not who she seems. Uwe receives a new target and uses the opportunity to set a deadly trap for Kleo.

5.o: Uwe is left cleaning up a mess. Sven unmasks a double agent, while Kleo heads for her family cabin in search of answers.

6.o: With the future of Europe hanging in the balance, Kleo prepares herself for a final confrontation in Moscow.

1.o: Ichiro Kuga is a manga artist struggling to support his two young siblings, and he's in need of an assistant. Shiori Goshiki wishes to become that assistant, but her background is unusual in more ways than one.

2.o: Ichiro learns the hard way some of the physical implications of his newfound bond with Shiori. Now that she has a permanent place to live, it's time for the two of them to do some shopping.

3.o: Shiori and Ichiro explore the ins and outs of how daily life will function under the terms of their Engagement Pact. Ichiro's friend and mentor Momoka comes over for a visit, but this has an unexpected effect on Shiori's state of mind.

4.o: Rainy weather complicates plans for Shiori and the Kugas. When Machi and Fumio are down in the dumps as a result, Ichiro and Shiori get creative in their efforts to make the most of the day's disappointing weather.

5.t: At the Zoo With the Princess
5.o: Shiori and the Kugas finally make it to the zoo, and it's Shiori's first time visiting one. It's also her first date with Ichiro since they officially became a couple, and there are unexpected hurdles to clear.

6.o: Shiori meets with mixed results when she tries to get additional assistant work with local manga artists. In an effort to encourage her, Ichiro takes a leaf from her book and decides to put his thoughts down on paper.

7.t: A Slight Fever With the Princess
7.o: Shiori goes with the Kugas to visit their father's grave, as her relationship with Ichiro slowly deepens. When she comes down with a fever, it becomes Ichiro's turn to help her get back on her feet again.

8.o: It's time for the Christmas party, an annual tradition at Hiiragi Apartments. Shiori continues to grow closer to Ichiro, but she also spends time with some of the other friends she's made since her arrival.

9.t: A Hot Spring With the Princess
9.o: Some amazing New Year's luck sees Shiori and the Kugas take a trip to a hot spring resort. But Shiori's mother Miyako is growing impatient, and she begins taking steps to get her daughter to return to the island.

10.o: Shiori's parents track her down and confront her in person about her situation, which she and Ichiro now must find a way to explain. Can they convince them to let her stay, and is there any way to annul the Engagement Pact?

11.o: The fated day arrives, the day when Ichiro and Shiori will annul their Engagement Pact. But there's a risk their feelings for each other will vanish in the process, and there's no way to be sure without performing the ceremony.

12.o: With the pact no longer hanging over them, Shiori and Ichiro are free to live and love on their own terms. But that doesn't necessarily mean there are no complications left to address.

1.t: How Hayley Got Her Groove Back
1.o: Hayley is a talented teen who created a project that pairs preschool children with senior citizens. Marsai aims to surprise her with a dream room makeover that modernizes her childhood bedroom and transforms a forgotten loft into her own dance studio.

2.o: Marsai tackles emerging football sensation, Bryan, a straight-A student who also helps out adults with special needs. Marsai's own talented team surprises this athlete with a New York City loft-inspired bedroom that shows off his love of the Big Apple.

3.o: Marsai meets Sophia, a teen who walks to the beat of her own drum. She needs a space that shows off her individuality and allows more room for her bearded dragon, Chedda, so Marsai transforms her bedroom from typically teen to outrageously artistic!

4.o: Marsai ambushes Kayden, a teenager who stands as a strong advocate against bullying and racism. Along with her dream team, Marsai transforms this teen's dull bedroom into a peaceful oasis by reimagining her boring bathroom as a relaxing, in-home spa.

5.t: New Pad for Old School Khloe
5.o: Khloe considers herself an old soul in the body of a teenager and regularly does charity work with the homeless. To give back, Marsai and her design team revamp her cramped room with all the flair of the 1970s, complete with disco ball.

6.o: Zion is an aspiring chef who moved into the guesthouse when his Grandma joined the household. Marsai and her team rescue him from what's become a storage facility by creating the coolest teen pad ever, complete with bubble chairs and a DIY hoverbed!

7.o: Marsai meets Galilea, a budding young artist who gives stuffed unicorns to kids at children's hospitals. The team draws from her love of Frida Kahlo and Japanese-inspired design to give Galilea a unique, artistic space where she can keep on creating.

8.o: Marsai meets a teenage whiz kid named Chloe who's engineered the fire-fighting robot, Hydra. Chloe's room hasn't changed since she was a kid, so Marsai and her team use their ingenuity to design a modern upgrade that leaves her speechless.

1.o: During the carnival on the island of Neboa, a young woman is brutally murdered with a mask on her face. Lieutenant Monica Ortiz goes to investigate.

2.o: The finding of a new corpse suggests that the murderer follows the same steps as those of 1919 and 1989 with the same number of murdered.

3.o: While Monica suspects that Cascudo saw the Urco, and will do everything possible so that the murderer does not kill again, Anton wants to find out who is the man with whom his daughter had a relationship.

4.o: New suspects appear in the town's murder cases.

5.o: When Ana's backpack turns up, Monica orders Ana's friends to be interrogated again, since there is something they're not saying; she is also on the trail of the thief who stole tape number nine and assaulted Carmela in her home.

6.o: Alejandro and Gonzalo are the main suspects; discovering the killer isn't the only problem for Monica; after surprising her daughter with Emilio, she knows she can't lose sight of her for a second.

7.o: Monica's daughter is the latest victim of the Urco, forcing Carmela to take the reins of an increasingly compromised investigation; the main suspect is still Gonzalo, but Monica is no longer so sure.

8.o: The carnival is coming to an end, and Monica already knows the identity of Urco; her only desire is to hunt him down and avenge the death of her daughter.

1.o: Yasemin, one of the famous actresses in Turkey, has been living a double life for many years: actress by day, vigilante killer by night.

2.o: Since Yasemin killed someone irrelevant at her last hunt, everyone around her is a threat now.

3.o: Yasemin sees someone suspicious in the video of the award ceremony and traces him till his house.

4.o: As a result of his investigations, Ahmet realizes that a company called Zone 22 is after Yasemin.

5.o: Yasemin's going to attend a shooting with her amazing image at one of the fancy hotels of Istanbul.

6.o: Yusuf's murder is well-received at the station. Semih thinks that this will lead them to the Hunter.

7.o: Faced up to Mazhar, Yasemin now has to do whatever he wants. Meanwhile, Günes is after Yasemin.

8.o: Yasemin and Taner attend a TV show together. Taner dies in a horrific way on live broadcast.

1.o: Surrounded by her friends and family, Fara contributes as best she can to organizing the wedding of her sister Safia and her groom Maxime. Meanwhile, their grandmother Rania refuses to leave the kitchen to join the ceremony. Fara is ready to do whatever it takes to avoid a family drama.

2.o: Though Maxime has fully embraced his newfound spiritual path since the wedding, Safia is extremely angry at her sister. Fara knows she’d better fix the damage she did if she intends to return to the family home. But this could prove a bigger task than she can face, especially in the middle of Ramadan, which she has decided to observe properly for once.

3.o: Things are getting serious between Nassim and Cherifa, causing Fara to grow increasingly jealous. Mariam urges her to reveal her feelings to Nassim because she risks losing whatever chances she still has. But first, she needs to stop by the junkyard with Damien to pick up what’s left of her food truck.

4.o: Fara is hesitant to join her group of friends for the France-Algeria match in the evening. The event reminds her of how her mother Najet, shown as a young woman in 1975, met her father Kader. It’s an opportunity to dig into the past and better grasp what’s gone wrong with the present.

5.o: In the middle of the night, Damien discovers Rania lying on the kitchen floor. Her stay in the hospital with everyone coming to visit becomes a chance for them to finally settle their scores. For Fara, it’s the moment of truth that spurs her decision to set out in search of her estranged father.

6.o: Fara and Safia are in Oran, with two days to find a replacement for Rania’s traditional bread-baking dish. Fara uses this time to get to better know her Algerian family and the country, which irks Safia, who can’t wait to get on the next plane back. But things take a turn when they meet Aris, who becomes their local guide.

7.o: Safia has convinced Fara to drive through the region of Kabylia with Aris, who promises that it’s where they'll find a baking dish like Rania’s old one. Though the landscapes are stunning, Safia is flustered by their Kabyle guide. But what exactly are his intentions for the two sisters?

8.o: Fara and Safia are already in a sorry state when they land in France and are immediately faced with Rania’s funeral. The entire family is gathered in the Alaoui home, where Fara finds herself at the center of all the tension. In honor of her grandmother, she'll have to take charge for the first time in her life.

1.o: A massive scandal turns Bella 'Bae' Chowdhury's perfect life upside down, as she downgrades from rich heiress to broke homeless. With her South Delhi family and friends disowning her, Bae finds herself on the streets, armed with little more than her fashion sense and fortitude. Where to next?

2.o: Bae’s search for a solution leads her to Mumbai, but it’s not going to be so easy to fix everything. When family fails her, it is fun new friends like Saira that prop her up. But her woes aren’t over as Bae girds herself to face the fire of an influential man.

3.o: Bae takes on her first proper job as a journalist with Neel's help. She may have also found a flat and a flat mate in Tammarrah...and maybe even her first story.

4.o: Bae is struggling with tussles with Tammarah at home, while Satyajit at work makes her life a living hell. To add to the confusion, a blast from her past shows up at her doorstep.

5.o: Bae plunges into the investigation of an important story with help from Tammarrah, Saira and Prince, while her love life hangs on a precipice with Neel, Prince and Agastya in the mix.

6.t: Bae Tries to be a Journalist
6.o: Bae’s spirit to get to the bottom of the story is deterred when she finds herself forced to confront the past she has been working to move on from. When she lands on her face, help comes from an unexpected source.

7.o: Reinvigorated, Bae goes all in on her investigation to help the person who trusted her, leading her and her friends to land up in a soup with a dangerous man.

8.o: With her besties by her side, Bae takes on the men she wants to bring to justice, and her own shame, in a big televised spectacle. Is Bae ready to bring it on?

1.o: A young man begins a new life at Amagami shrine, and meets the three sisters who live there.

2.o: The sisters plot to drive Uryu away by making him do all the chores.

3.o: Uryu has marriage meetings with all three of the sisters.

4.o: The sisters are forced to get 5,000 people to come to their upcoming festival, or they'll have to sell the shrine.

5.o: Trouble strikes on the day of the festival! Will enough people come to save the shrine?

6.o: Uryu reflects on what happened after the shrine festival, and Asahi offers to help find the answer to his question.

7.t: Dream and Moon and Dream ~New Moon~
7.o: The sisters seek help from the priestess who trained them, but are met with an unexpected demand.

8.t: Dream and Moon and Dream ~Half Moon~
8.o: Yae wonders about her future, while Asahi thinks of moving away.

9.t: Dream and Moon and Dream ~Full Moon~
9.o: The girls give Yomiko the answer, and Uryu promises to support their dreams.

10.o: With spring break over, Uryu unexpectedly finds himself at the same school as Yuna.

11.t: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Prelude~
11.o: As the sisters and Uryu go out for a late-night trip, Uryu wonders about something strange he found...

12.t: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Connections~
12.o: The sisters, Makoto, and Uryu arrive at Inari Shrine, where Uryu has a strange experience.

13.t: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Love~
13.o: Uryu remembers how he first met Yae, and Yae makes a big decision.

14.o: Asahi is training for a marathon, but an unexpected rainstorm moves it to the day of a big festival at the shrine.

15.t: The Scales That Hold Wishes ~Going Back~
15.o: After failing to escape from the time loop, Uryu is forced to consider what it is that Asahi really wants.

16.t: The Scales That Hold Wishes ~Going Forward~
16.o: Asahi realizes what it is she really wants as the loop comes to an end.

17.t: The Send-Off Fires and the Vow With the Gods
17.o: When Uryu's grades start to slip, the sisters make a decision.

18.o: Yuna and Uryu are forced to deal with a shocking occurrence.

19.o: While Yuna and Uryu get used to their new life, Yuna's best friend notices something is wrong.

20.o: As the culture festival comes to a close, Yuna reflects on what really drives her.

21.o: Shirahi is heartbroken when she sees the growing relationship between Uryu and the sisters.

22.o: Uryu finds himself trapped in another world where he lives with Shirahi.

23.o: Uryu discovers the truth about what led him to this world.

24.t: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
24.o: Uryu and Shirahi make a choice about their future.

1.o: Mélanie Diore has turned her six-year-old daughter Kimmy into an Internet star thanks to her "Happy Recess" channel and its millions of followers. When the child influencer is kidnapped, Sara Roussel finds herself in charge of the investigation. She must dive into a world she knows nothing about, and into the family that seems to have a lot to hide.

2.o: After receiving a message from the kidnapper accompanied by a recording of Kimmy's voice, Mélanie publicly reveals her daughter's abduction. In the midst of a media storm, the police continue their investigation. The Diores may have millions of fans, but they also have their share of haters, and the kidnapper could be among them.

3.o: The investigation continues. Could the kidnapper be David Bouthier, the former reality TV star who shares a mysterious past with Mélanie Diore? Or Valentin Lavalle, the misogynist released by the police? As media pressure mounts for the Diore family, the arrival of Mélanie's mother Isabelle adds fuel to the fire. As Bruno pulls away, Mélanie turns to Sara for help. The two women grow closer.

4.o: Bruno is arrested following David Bouthier's revelations. Mélanie becomes convinced of the guilt of her rival Fabrice Perrot, who is profiting from Kimmy's disappearance. Sara follows this trail while Malik explores the pedophile angle. But the clock is ticking, the police are in a rut, and Sara loses her footing. Back home, Bruno discovers an SD card with terrifying contents in Sammy's room.

5.o: Sara wakes up in the police station and finds Bruno and Sammy who have come to give her the SD card. Sara refuses to believe the images she sees. Following the previous day's slip-up, Mélanie complains to Salomé, who pulls Sara off the case. Nonetheless, Sara delves into Mélanie's past and makes a discovery that points her in the direction of Kimmy's kidnapper.

6.o: Baptiste and Sara find Kimmy's cuddly toy and no longer have any doubt as to the kidnapper's identity. While Baptiste warns the rest of the group, Sara sets off alone for the Ardennes to look for Kimmy. On the spot, the local gendarmerie organizes a search party. In custody, Mélanie grows impatient.

1.o: Harold of Wessex warns his father, Earl Godwin, of a rival's treachery – but he is ignored.

2.o: Threatened by those in power in France and England, William and Harold each face grave danger, their families in peril. Refuge in Flanders offers hope for new mother Matilda, while vengeful Lady Emma hounds the Godwins.

3.o: Harold risks returning to Wessex for his wife, while William plots against Henry in France as home truths compromise family ties.

4.o: Crowned heads are endangered as Harold fights for his family's rights and William tracks his royal foe.

5.o: Harold and Edith risk their lives to bargain with William but get a guarded reception. Harold's siblings face hardships trying to secure their family's future.

6.o: Ambition drives William and Harold to each seek costly alliances, against the advice of their womenfolk, to enhance their chances of winning the crown.

7.o: Sacrifices have to be made when Harold strikes against a Viking invader, and William seeks a fleet. Edith fears for the future, while Matilda moves to secure hers.

8.o: Harold’s depleted English forces rush to meet William's assault on the south coast. The resulting brutal battle's outcome is unpredictable.

1.o: Inspired by his grandson, Grandpa Farouk starts writing stories from the life of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), hoping to instill his noble character in every Muslim child—at home, in school, and in the world around them.

As the nation is rocked by a scandal involving 'national actor' Kang Eun-seok, who is accused of having an inappropriate sexual relationship with a high school girl, Yoo-jeong, Hyun-jin, a lawyer at L&J, struggles to prove Eun-seok’s guilt. By chance, Hyun-jin overhears a conversation about the Eun-seok – Yoo-jeong case at the home of her former lover, Jun-hyeok, and is taken aback to realize that the case is far bigger than she had imagined.

2.o: Jun-hyeok is found dead, and Yoo-jeong claims that she killed him. Hyun-jin finds it hard to believe, so she tries to find out the truth behind Ra-young and Shin-jae. Hyun-jin meets Seon-hwa, hoping she’d share some information about Jun-hyeok. Meanwhile, Ra-young comes home, only to be attacked by a mysterious man.

3.t: The Consequences of the Statement Recanting
3.o: Seon-gyu takes DNA samples from Ra-young and Hyun-jin to compare them with the DNA found on an earring discovered at Jun-hyeok’s house. Ra-young pulls some strings so that the police don’t get their hands on Hyun-jin’s DNA. On the day of the crime scene reenactment, Yoo-jeong recants her statement.

4.o: Ra-young goes to see Min-seo at the restaurant she works at to convince her to get their help. Seon-gyu accuses Hyun-jin of visiting Jun-hyeok’s place on the day of his death. Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

5.o: Park Ju Hwan visits Ra Young at her office, leaving her shaken. He tells her that he’s going to reinvestigate his case from 20 years ago. Shin Jae finds out that Ju Hwan is part of the Connect scheme. Meanwhile, Attorney Kwon Jung Hyeon takes over LnJ as the new head in order to send Shin Jae to Haeil.

6.o: Hyun Jin shares the news with Seon Kyu that she’s pregnant. However, at the doctor’s appointment, Seon Kyu realizes that the baby might not be his. Jun Hyeok’s laptop gets recovered, and the voice recording of an interview with Yoo Jeong is revealed. Meanwhile, Lee Seon Hwa steals Jun Hyeok’s laptop for the corrupt cop.

7.o: Seon-hwa is found dead in an abandoned building, but Jun-hyeok’s laptop is nowhere to be found. Shin-jae decides to marry Tae-joo, announcing to her mother that L&J will go independent. Meanwhile, another victim of Connect is found at Magan Hotel, and Shin-jae asks Tae-joo's help to rescue her.

8.o: Ra Young manages to save Yeon Hee from Je Yeol. Hyeon Jin saves Da Eun, the victim of Connect, from the hotel room and transfers her to the hospital. Ra Young exposes Connect In live on a news show. After the show airs, the victims of Connect visit the LnJ office to reveal the truth.

9.o: With enough statements gathered from the victims, LnJ decides to go public with the list of Connect In’s clients. As a result of this exposure, a significant social uproar rises, and Joint Investigation Headquarters is formed. However, the lead prosecutors at the Joint Investigation HQ turn out to be Haeil’s clients, and Shin Jae immediately realises her mom is behind it.

10.o: Ra Young gets imprisoned for murdering Je Yeol. While looking for ways to get Ra Young out, Shin Jae and Hyun Jin find out who Han Min Seo really is. Shin Jae confronts Baek Tae Joo after finding out that he was the mastermind behind Connect In. Ra Young’s trial is held under unfavourable circumstances, with no additional witnesses coming.

Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

12.o: Ra-young reveals that Baek Tae-ju is the man behind Connect In during The Prime’s Technical Demonstration. Ra-young and Hyun-jin suggest Shin-jae return to L&J, but she refuses. Shin-Jae tries her best to clean up the damage caused by Haeil, but she faces difficulties due to one man who remains an obstacle until the very end.

1.o: العميل كيم هو موظف براتب عادي قلقه الأكبر هو كيفية التواصل مع ابنته ( مين جي ) حتى تختفي فجأة

2.o: يستخدم العميل كيم مهاراته من أيامه كعميل سري متخصص في عمليات إنزال العدو القاسية

3.o: يعيد العميل كيم التواصل مع زملائه الأصدقاء والعملاء السريين السابقين ( سونغ هان سو ) و( بارك جين تشيول ) في بحثه عن ( مين جي )

4.o: وضعته تصرفات العميل كيم المحفوفة بالمخاطر على رادار الأعداء في الماضي والحاضر عندما يضرب الخطر يصعد ( هان سو ) و ( جين تشيول ) للمساعدة في إنقاذ اليوم

5.o: يتبادل العميل كيم الضربات مع عميل العدو الذي يطارده فقط ليدرك أنه صديق قديم وفي الوقت نفسه تحاول مين جي الهروب من تلقاء نفسها

6.o: تجد ( مين جي ) نفسها في وضع مأزوي حتى يظهر العميل الخاص ( جونغ سانغ ) تحاول مديرية البعثات الخاصة جذب المدير كيم

7.o: لم شمل المدير كيم و ( مين جي ) أخيراً ولكن الطريق إلى السلامة أبعد ما يكون عن السلاسة في وقت لاحق يضطر العميل كيم إلى اتخاذ قرار صعب

8.o: تم القبض على العميل كيم وتعذيبه  حتى تدخل مديرية البعثات الخاصة بمهمة نهائية يضع ( جو قانغ تشان ) خطة للانتقام

9.o: مع فشل مهمة العميل كيم يتعاون آباء العملاء الثلاثة مع ( سانغ ) لمحاربة طريقهم للخروج  لكن ( قانغ تشان ) لديه خدعة أخرى في جعبته

10.o: يجب على العميل كيم الآن اتخاذ خيار حاسم مع ( هان سو ) و ( جين تشيول ) دفعه إلى حافة الهاوية هل سيتمكن العميل كيم من الحفاظ على سلامة ( مين جي ) ؟
